brief: un video para mi bar de tapas en Madrid, para Instagram

context.audience: locals and visitors looking for a place for the evening (Spanish-speaking)

concept: In Madrid the night starts at the bar: one tapa, one toast, and nobody goes home early.
plan_outline: 1. ECU · top · static · bar counter, warm tungsten light · a hand drops a plate of patatas bravas, sauce gleaming (2 s, the hook)
2. MCU · eye · handheld · same bar · a bartender pours vermut from height, a smile (3 s)
3. MS · eye · static · same bar · four friends clink glasses, laughing (3 s)
4. CU · eye · push in · same bar · jamón being sliced, translucent (3 s)
5. WS · eye · static · the street outside at night · the bar's light spilling onto the cobbles, people at the door (4 s)
6. End card (page) · 'Calle de la Cava Baja · Hasta tarde' as the user gives it (3 s)
why: The reply is in Spanish; prompts in English; the card uses the user's Spanish words with their accents.
Warm tungsten practicals and dark wood: the look of a Madrid night without neon.
Groups are four people at a counter at most, in a medium shot.
